content: {"doneWhen":{"all":[{"path":"body.x","op":"==","value":11},{"path":"body.y","op":"<=","value":2}]},"modes":[{"id":"navigate-to-ladder","priority":10,"when":{"all":[{"path":"body.x","op":">=","value":0}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"go-to-ladder"}}],"skills":[{"name":"go-to-ladder","skill":"async (b) => { const p = await b.body(); if (p.x === 11 && p.y <= 2) return; const ms = await b.monsters(); const near = ms.filter(m => Math.abs(m.x - p.x) + Math.abs(m.y - p.y) <= 1); if (near.length) { const m = near[0]; await b.faceAndPress(m.x, m.y, 'ControllerX', 0); await b.wait(150); } const q = await b.body(); if (q.x < 11) { await b.walkTo(11, q.y, 'stand'); } else if (q.x > 11) { await b.walkTo(11, q.y, 'stand'); } const r = await b.body(); if (r.y > 1) { await b.walkTo(r.x, 1, 'stand'); } const s = await b.body(); if (s.x !== 11) { await b.walkTo(11, s.y, 'stand'); } b.log('at ' + s.x + ',' + s.y); }","check":"async (b) => { const p = await b.body(); const ok = (p.x === 11 && p.y <= 2); return { ok, detail: 'player at ' + p.x + ',' + p.y }; }"}]}
